Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: P1 - stella-vpc (private) experiencing outbound timeouts to model backends and intermittent ALB 502s. Auto-page sent. thread_ts=1775124310

Priya (SRE): Acknowledged. Symptoms: dedicated pool requests from tenant stella are failing with connect timeouts and 502s from the ingress ALB. Start time ~ 11:05 UTC.

Elena (Customer Success): Customer reported mass failures for inference calls; they mention errors after a config push earlier this morning. Theyre asking for ETA and mitigation.

Tom (Network): Looking at VPC flow logs and route tables. I see the NAT gateway for the stella-prod-subnet lost its route association to the private NAT (asg-rtb-03) after a tagged-route cleanup at 11:03 UTC. Traffic to 10.72.0.0/16 (model fleet) is being blackholed. Also seeing increased TCP RSTs to ALB 10.11.22.33.

Noor (Eng-Infra): That cleanup was from a bulk route pruning job. It erroneously matched the stella tag set. We're rolling a restore of the route associations now.

Priya (SRE): Can we test connectivity from one of the stella pool nodes to a model backend IP? Also check ALB target health.

Tom (Network): From a host in stella pool:
```
# ping 10.72.5.8
PING 10.72.5.8 (10.72.5.8): Destination Host Unreachable
# nc -vz 10.72.5.8 443
nc: connect to 10.72.5.8 port 443 (tcp) failed: Connection timed out
```
ALB target group health: many targets UNHEALTHY, 0/4 healthy for pool-targetgroup-stella.

Noor (Eng-Infra): Route association restored at 11:18 UTC. Re-associating rtb-03 to stella-prod-subnet.

Priya (SRE): After route restore, retesting connectivity:
```
# curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 https://10.72.5.8:443/health
{"status":"ok"}
```
Good. But ALB 502s persist for a short window; looks like backend drained.

OpsBot: rolling-reconnect pool:stella-targets started (action=re-register-targets)

Noor (Eng-Infra): Re-registered targets and triggered immediate health checks at 11:22 UTC. Target group back to 4/4 healthy by 11:27 UTC.

Elena (Customer Success): Customer reports partial recovery and slow ramp. They're asking if we can provide a short-term hosted fallback while we confirm stability.

Sam (Product): Hosted fallback is possible but needs opt-in from customer. Also want to ensure tenant isolation and no cross-tenant traffic.

Priya (SRE): Quick mitigations and checks we did:
- Restored route association to NAT/private route table (Tom/Noor)
- Re-registered ALB targets (Noor)
- Cleared stale connections on NAT gateway (recycled NAT ENIs)
- Validated DNS: internal DNS A records pointed correctly to ALB IPs (no TTL change)

Tom (Network): Root cause appears to be an overbroad tag selector in the route-prune job that removed route association for rtb-03 affecting stella's subnet only. Not a security-group edit.

Priya (SRE): Customer impact: P1 for stella dedicated pool (traffic failed for ~14 minutes). Total mitigation time: 11:03 -> 11:18 for route restore, 11:27 to full health.

Elena (Customer Success): Customer wants written assurance about tenant isolation and a timeline for fixes.

Noor (Eng-Infra): Confirming: no inbound security groups were modified; this was a route association change. No evidence of cross-tenant traffic nor data exposure. We will include NAT logs for verification in the postmortem.

Sam (Product): Ask: how many other pools were in the tag group for that route prune? Could this have broader blast radius?

Tom (Network): Scan shows two other subnets had their associations touched but they were untagged so pruning skipped them. Preliminary count: only stella-prod-subnet impacted.

Priya (SRE): Action items/live runbook updates: 
- Add a pre-run validation for tag selectors in route-prune job (block if subset matches any production-dedicated-pool tags)
- Add automatic rollback that re-associates route tables if healthchecks detect outbound blackhole to model subnets
- Add alerting rule linking route association changes to affected pool targets and page network on-call

Noor (Eng-Infra): I'll open infra ticket INF-2879 with incident tags: route-prune, nat, vpc, stella-customer. ETA for hotfix to validator: 72 hours.

Elena (Customer Success): Customer requested a short mitigation doc: minimal route table and NAT config for dedicated pools they can reference. Will also ask if they want hosted fallback temporarily.

Priya (SRE): On-call handoff: I'll monitor for 30 more minutes, then hand to night SRE. Please keep watching ALB target health and NAT metrics.

OpsBot: incident-update:mitigated partial at 11:27 UTC; status=monitoring

Sam (Product): We'll prepare customer comms stating timeline, root cause (route-prune tag selector), mitigation steps, and statement that no data cross-tenant access occurred. Please include logs.

Priya (SRE): Final notes: avoid running tag-prune against route associations in prod until validator is in place. Documenting commands used for rollback in postmortem.

Elena (Customer Success): Thanks team, customer acknowledges recovery and requests follow-up postmortem and suggested preventative configs. Keeping channel open until postmortem.

Oncall Bot: Incident 1775124310 marked as mitigated at 11:27 UTC. Postmortem requested: yes.
